rounds.text: The bear case against Ace Men Engg Works Ltd centers on an absolute failure of capital efficiency and returns, as evidenced by an ROCE of 0.01% against a sector benchmark of 13.6% [E6]. This abysmal operational reality is reinforced by filed statements showing both ROCE and ROE sitting stagnant at 0.0% [E7, E8]. Investors are asked to pay a price-to-book multiple of 1.86x [E1] (or 1.99x according to key ratios [E5]) for a ₹ 124 Cr market capitalisation company [E2] that generates zero return on its equity and capital employed. Furthermore, the business offers no interim relief or cash return to shareholders, evidenced by a dividend yield of exactly 0.00% [E3]. Conceded: the stock currently sits at 74% of its 52-week range [E4] and trades at a discount to the sector P/B benchmark of 3.77x [E5], but these metrics provide little comfort when underlying returns are completely non-existent.
